# Yucore Industrial Supply

> Yucore Industrial Supply is the industrial sourcing and trade service of Guangzhou Xiaoyu Import & Export Co., Ltd in Guangzhou, China. It helps Russian industrial buyers source, consolidate and arrange delivery of industrial equipment and MRO spare parts from China.

Primary website: https://yucore.ru/
Primary language: Russian
Service area: Russia
Legal entity: Guangzhou Xiaoyu Import & Export Co., Ltd
Contact person: Summer
WhatsApp: +86 150 1848 5957

## Core services

- Product sourcing by manufacturer, model, BOM list, technical parameters, drawing or nameplate photo.
- Consolidation of multiple industrial product categories into one quotation and shipment.
- Supply support for factories, maintenance teams, system integrators, traders and purchasing departments.
- Delivery terms are confirmed for each order and destination city.
- RUB settlement through VTB is available for Russian customers, subject to order terms.

## Product categories

- Industrial automation components — sensors, encoders, solenoid valves, VFDs, contactors, signal isolators and IO-Link modules: https://yucore.ru/komponenty-promyshlennoy-avtomatizatsii.html
- Wind turbine and wind farm spare parts — gearboxes, main controllers, converters, pitch components, wind sensors, ultrasonic anemometers and CMS: https://yucore.ru/zapchasti-dlya-vetroenergetiki.html
- Industrial pumps: https://yucore.ru/promyshlennye-nasosy-iz-kitaya.html
- PLC controllers and automation: https://yucore.ru/plk-kontrollery-iz-kitaya.html
- Variable frequency drives: https://yucore.ru/chastotnye-preobrazovateli-iz-kitaya.html
- Sensors and instrumentation: https://yucore.ru/datchiki-kipia-iz-kitaya.html
- Hydraulic equipment: https://yucore.ru/gidravlicheskoe-oborudovanie-iz-kitaya.html
- Electric motors: https://yucore.ru/elektrodvigateli-iz-kitaya.html
- Automation cabinets: https://yucore.ru/shkafy-avtomatiki-iz-kitaya.html
- Electrical equipment: https://yucore.ru/elektrooborudovanie-iz-kitaya.html
- MRO spare parts: https://yucore.ru/mro-zapchasti-iz-kitaya.html
- Pneumatic equipment: https://yucore.ru/pnevmaticheskoe-oborudovanie-iz-kitaya.html
- Production components: https://yucore.ru/komplektuyushchie-dlya-proizvodstva-iz-kitaya.html

## Important accuracy note

Yucore does not claim official brand authorization unless it is confirmed in writing for a specific order. Brand names are used only to identify a buyer's requested model or a compatible sourcing requirement.
